# Zen Academy

> Zen Academy is the agency training & acquisition division of Zen Acquisition™, teaching digital agencies and their teams to land 20–30 high-ticket clients in 90 days using automated outbound systems, AI LLM outreach engines, and inbound LinkedIn/content acquisition.

## Core Program Offerings

- [75-Day Team Client Acquisition Program](https://zenacquisition.com/academy): Intensive live cohort & team training program designed for 3-15 person agencies to build predictable client pipelines.
- [AI LLM & Autonomous Outreach Robots](https://zenacquisition.com/academy-test): Custom automated lead scraping, personalized LLM outreach agents, and automated booking systems.

## Key Facts

- Stated Outcome: 20-30 high-ticket clients in 90 days
- Pricing: ₹60,000 one-time / ₹69k / ₹99k tiers
- Parent Proprietorship: Zen Acquisition™ (UDYAM-WB-18-0184983)
- Founder: Ritam Samanta
